notes: kb/Work PB5130 (landed). §1989:A.2.17.3 AR1 bounds the year below only ("It must be an integer greater than 1600.") and DDD by the year's length. At --std 85 CobolDate.IntegerOfDay takes the unbounded year (DialectBehavior.IntegerDateFormBounded inactive): INTEGER-OF-DAY (10000001) is 3067672 and (10000366) 3068037; the integer screen (CheckArgumentClasses, IntegerViolation) refuses a non-integer argument and 1604366 gives 1461. Witnesses 1989-AR-A_2_17_3-1 and pb5130_integer_date_year_10000_85.

next.reason: 1985: "It must be an integer greater than 1600."; 2023: "It shall be an integer greater than 1600 and less than 10000.". 2023 adds an explicit upper bound on YYYY (less than 10000) that the 1985 text does not state; the YYYYDDD form and the DDD rule are otherwise the same.
